items.stem: In a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture, what is the typical purpose of the bronze layer?

options.text: Store raw ingested data with minimal transformation
options.rationale: Correct: the bronze layer captures raw ingested data, preserving source fidelity before cleansing.
Dashboards are not a data layer.

options.text: Replace the need for silver and gold layers
options.rationale: Bronze is the first of three layers, not a replacement.

items.explanation: Correct: the bronze layer captures raw ingested data, preserving source fidelity before cleansing.

items.stem: Which Databricks feature provides incremental, exactly-once file ingestion as new files arrive?

options.rationale: Overwrite reprocesses everything and is not incremental.
Correct: Auto Loader incrementally and efficiently ingests new files as they land, tracking what has been processed.
A static query does not track new arrivals.
Manual upload is neither incremental nor automated.

items.explanation: Correct: Auto Loader incrementally and efficiently ingests new files as they land, tracking what has been processed.

items.stem: Which TWO support governance and least-privilege access on Databricks? (Select TWO)

options.text: Unity Catalog grants on tables and schemas
options.rationale: Correct: Unity Catalog manages fine-grained access to data assets.

options.text: Scoped service principals for automated jobs
options.rationale: Correct: scoped service principals limit automation permissions.

options.text: Sharing one admin token with all engineers
options.rationale: Shared admin tokens break least privilege.

options.text: Disabling access controls to speed development

items.explanation: Both keyed options are correct; all-or-nothing scoring requires exactly the keyed set.
